atomicity.reason: One obligation: session start is conditional on the inlet being locked.

comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained; CHG and CCS are project/domain terms.

feasibility.reason: Standard interlock, implementable and contradicts nothing.

parent_fit.reason: Constrains when the session control (parent ARCH_CHG_SESSION_CONTROL_CCS1 'runs the session with the charger') may start a session - a distinct part of the parent's session obligation.

unambiguity.reason: 'start a charging session' (ISO 15118 session setup vs. energy transfer) and the source of the 'reported as locked' signal are not pinned down; core meaning is unaffected.
unambiguity.suggestion: Name the start event (e.g. session setup request) and the lock-status signal source.

variant_consistency.reason: Lives in the bev-only subsystems/chg folder and refines via `<<eu: CCS2, CCS1>>` using the named variant eu; market is an exhaustive eu/na Kconfig choice, so the resolved parent exists in every product where the swreq exists.

verifiability.reason: Testable by attempting a session start with the lock reported unlocked/locked and observing whether the session starts.

summary: Clear single start precondition refining the active CCS session-control element; minor ambiguity about what 'start' and 'reported' mean.
